requirements.text: The mobile banking app must provide real-time transaction notifications including transaction amounts, merchant names, and updated balances.
Customers must have the ability to customize their notification preferences.
The app must allow customers to freeze and unfreeze their debit and credit cards instantly.
The app must provide automated monthly spending breakdowns, categorizing spending by type.
Customers must be able to set personalized spending limits and receive alerts when approaching those limits.
The app must enable instant peer-to-peer payments.
The app must include a robust in-app support feature, such as live chat or AI-assisted help.
The app must integrate seamlessly with the existing core banking system through the current API layer.
The app must comply with PSD2 regulations, including strong customer authentication for payment initiations.
The app must adhere to GDPR regulations for customer financial data processing and storage.
The app must comply with Central Bank of Ireland regulations for consumer protection and responsible lending.
The app must maintain backwards compatibility with the existing version for at least six months during the transition.
User engagement levels must be tracked by measuring frequency of app logins and time spent in the app.
Customer satisfaction ratings must achieve a minimum of 4.2 on both the App Store and Google Play within six months of launch.
Transaction notification response rates must be tracked to assess user interaction with notifications.
The app must ensure 99.95% uptime to maintain customer trust.
Compliance metrics must be monitored to ensure adherence to regulatory requirements.
Customer feedback must be gathered through surveys or in-app prompts for continuous improvement.
New feature adoption rates must be tracked to assess the effectiveness and popularity of new functionalities.
